_about: Copy to .authors.json at the root of a vault you SHARE with teammates. tools/authorship-guard.py then enforces: anyone may add; only a line's author may change or remove it, except that anyone may tick an unticked box ([ ] to [x]) in the files under tick_anyone; members/<login>/ and wiki/my-tasks/<login>.md belong to that person. List every email each person commits with.
